units.source_text: 第二天早晨，姑娘的父亲答复我同意这桩婚事。

en.t: The next morning, the girl's father replied that he agreed to the marriage.

units.source_text: 他一边高兴地听我说，再过不多久，过年时我带着他女儿来探望他，

en.t: He happily listened as I told him that before long, at New Year's, I would bring his daughter to visit him,

units.source_text: 一边慢慢腾腾地迈下雪山道，一直把这个多半会早死的未来女婿送到了车站。

en.t: and at the same time he slowly made his way down the snowy mountain road, seeing this future son-in-law, who would most likely die young, all the way to the station.
